plugin.note: Wilderness bandits have negligible defensive bonuses (all near +0 and defence level 17/55), so any accurate melee weapon works well; magic and ranged are equally viable given zero magic/ranged defence. Bring Wilderness risk gear as the camp is a deep PvP zone.

requirements: No combat, Slayer or quest requirement; assigned by Krystilia only.
Kills must occur in the Wilderness to count.
mechanics: The Bandit Camp east of the Ruins holds level 22 bandits (27 HP) and level 130 bandits (155 HP).
Bandits are aggressive to all players regardless of combat level.
Level 130 bandits drop Larran's keys and Slayer's enchantments while on a Krystilia task.
Defensive bonuses are negligible across all styles.

methods.label: Melee the camp
methods.summary: Kill the aggressive bandits at the camp with any accurate melee weapon.
steps: Travel to the Bandit Camp east of the Ruins in the Wilderness.
Attack the aggressive bandits; they have negligible defence.
Prefer the level 22 bandits for fast kills or the level 130 bandits for better drops on task.
notes: Take caution: this is a deep Wilderness PvP zone.

methods.label: Ranged or magic
methods.summary: Ranged or magic is equally effective given the bandits' zero magic and ranged defence.
recommendedFor: players who prefer to keep distance in the Wilderness
steps: Travel to the Bandit Camp east of the Ruins.
Attack the bandits with ranged or magic; their ranged and magic defence are both zero.
notes: Keeping distance can help spot approaching player killers earlier.

styleOptions.label: Melee
styleOptions.summary: Any accurate melee weapon shreds the low-defence bandits.
